name: Glasshouse Conservatory
description: Inside a Victorian glasshouse on a rainy afternoon. Raindrops run down the curved panes of the iron-ribbed vault while rain falls beyond the glass, palms, tree ferns, banana plants, monstera and flowering shrubs line a tiled aisle, a small fountain splashes and ripples, butterflies flutter between the beds, mist drifts up from the soil, sunbeams break through between showers and pendant lamps glow warmer towards dusk. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
